build_searxng_search_config: build a SearXNGSearchConfig instance to configure web search with a SearXNG API base URL
test_validate_environment: test validate_environment on SearXNGSearchConfig to set up auth headers with an optional API key
run_transform_search_request: run transform_search_request on SearXNGSearchConfig to convert a query and optional params into SearXNG API format
build_complete_url: build a complete SearXNG search URL with query parameters from transformed request data
summarize_transform_search_response: summarize transform_search_response on SearXNGSearchConfig to convert raw SearXNG JSON into unified SearchResponse objects
